intro: The Lattice bed gives you deep sleep and deeper storage. With its clean panels and colour-block tone, it helps you stay organised — while turning your bed into the boldest thing in the room.

features.title: Crafted to support, styled to impress
features.text: Made from high-quality engineered wood, our bed is built to be a reliable part of your everyday — strong, timeless, and effortlessly elegant.

features.title: Hydraulic lift that makes storage a breeze
features.text: With just a gentle lift, the underbed space opens up to reveal ample storage — no heavy lifting, just smooth, silent convenience. Plus, all Upmods beds come with versatile storage options to suit your unique lifestyle.

features.title: Your comfort zone, cushioned perfectly
features.text: The padded headboard offers soft support every time you lean back — ideal for reading, relaxing, or enjoying a quiet moment in bed.

features.title: Textured finish that brings the room together
features.text: The matte wood finish adds a layer of natural texture — giving your bedroom a relaxed, grounded feel that works with any interior style.

features.title: Storage that’s always within reach
features.text: Built-in headboard shelving and an added ledge keep your essentials beautifully arranged — from books to glasses, everything has its place.

name: Upmods Lattice King Size Engineered Wood Bed With Hydraulic Storage
